claims.content: To terminate a specific surveillance track and purge its associated data from the system.

goal.raw_text: To terminate a specific surveillance track and purge its associated data from the system.

claims.content: The transmission of EW product information shall be terminated when the information is no longer useful or time-related update requirements are not met.

trigger.raw_text: The transmission of EW product information shall be terminated when the information is no longer useful or time-related update requirements are not met.

claims.content: If the track to be terminated is a Drop Track message, the system shall not transmit the Terminate Action Field set to value 0, but instead report it as a drop track.
If the track being terminated has an associated correlation number (CN), the system must first handle the de-correlation process before proceeding with termination and purging.
If the C2 JU attempts to terminate a track that does not exist or has already been terminated, the system shall return an error or negative acknowledgement indicating the track cannot be found.
The specified surveillance track is terminated and no longer reported by the system.
All associated data for the terminated track is purged from the system's memory or database.
If the track was part of a correlation, the de-correlation process has been completed successfully.
Any dependent tracks or products that relied on the terminated track have been updated or removed as necessary.
